intro: I'm an algorithmic trading systems engineer. I design and build the infrastructure that makes systematic trading possible — data pipelines, strategy engines, backtesting, risk and execution.
paragraphs: I work mainly with crypto markets. My systems are built to be performant and resource-efficient, and to behave identically whether replaying history or running against live data.
I also use the systems I build for my own trading. That means I'm on both sides: I build the software and I depend on it. Every design decision is tested against real market conditions.
Open to full-time opportunities, trading-system projects, and collaborations.
